### 1. Architecture Overview
- **Core contract**: `storage/interface.go` defines `Appender` (v1) used across Prometheus ingestion paths (scrape, remote write, OTLP conversion, Mimir/Loki/Thanos consumers). It embeds `AppenderTransaction` (Commit/Rollback) and sub-interfaces for exemplars, histograms, metadata, and start-timestamp zero samples.
- **New requirement**: Add `AppendCTZeroSample(ref SeriesRef, l labels.Labels, t, ct int64) (SeriesRef, error)` to `Appender`. This parallels existing start-timestamp zero sample handling (AppendSTZeroSample) and must be added to all implementations.
- **Implementations to update** (found in Prometheus and downstream consumers):
  - Prometheus TSDB head appender (`tsdb/head_append.go`) implements `Appender` methods incl. `AppendSTZeroSample`.
  - Remote write timestamp trackers (`storage/remote/write.go`) implement `Appender` and count samples/histograms.
  - Fanout appender (`storage/fanout.go`) proxies to primary/secondary appenders and already handles `AppendSTZeroSample`/histograms/exemplars/metadata.
  - Test mock appenders (`util/teststorage/appender.go`) implement v1/v2 appenders for tests.
  - Mimir OTLP appender (`pkg/distributor/otlpappender/mimir_appender.go`) implements `storage.AppenderV2` (already supports created timestamps via `ct` param in V2 signature).
  - OTLP-to-Prometheus transaction in OpenTelemetry Collector (`receiver/prometheusreceiver/internal/transaction.go`) uses `storage.Appendable`/`Appender` to ingest samples and has `AppendSTZeroSample` handling.
  - Agent/TSDB appender V2 implementations (`tsdb/agent/db_append_v2.go`, head V2) are on V2 interface; v1 change may not directly apply, but downstream wrappers may expose v1.
- **Adapters/Proxies**: `storage/fanout.go` has both v1 and v2 appenders; needs new method to proxy.

### 2. Detailed Analysis
- **Contract definition change**: `storage/interface.go` currently defines:
  - `type Appender interface { AppenderTransaction; Append(ref SeriesRef, l labels.Labels, t int64, v float64) (SeriesRef, error); SetOptions(...); ExemplarAppender; HistogramAppender; MetadataUpdater; StartTimestampAppender }` (lines ~291-312) — add `AppendCTZeroSample(ref SeriesRef, l labels.Labels, t, ct int64) (SeriesRef, error)` alongside `StartTimestampAppender` methods (context: existing `AppendSTZeroSample` at ~334 in file).
- **Primary implementation (TSDB head)**: `tsdb/head_append.go` implements `Append`, `AppendSTZeroSample`, `AppendHistogram`, exemplars, metadata, commit/rollback on `headAppender` (lines ~421-520 show `Append` and `AppendSTZeroSample`). Must add new method to struct implementing `storage.Appender`.
- **Remote write tracker**: `storage/remote/write.go` `timestampTracker` implements `Append`, `AppendExemplar`, `AppendHistogram`, `AppendSTZeroSample`, `AppendHistogramSTZeroSample`, `UpdateMetadata` (lines ~307-359). Must implement new `AppendCTZeroSample`.
- **Fanout**: `storage/fanout.go` defines `fanoutAppender` implementing `Appender` methods including `AppendSTZeroSample`, histograms, exemplars, metadata (section map L163-293). Must add method to call primary and secondary appenders.
- **Mocks/tests**: `util/teststorage/appender.go` implements v1 appender methods including `AppendSTZeroSample` (~498) and histogram zero sample (~502). Must add `AppendCTZeroSample` recording behavior for tests.
- **OTLP transaction (collector)**: `receiver/prometheusreceiver/internal/transaction.go` implements `Append`, `AppendHistogram`, `AppendSTZeroSample`, `AppendHistogramSTZeroSample`, `Commit/Rollback` (lines ~355-371). If it implements the `storage.Appender` interface directly, it must add `AppendCTZeroSample`.
- **Mimir appender V2**: `pkg/distributor/otlpappender/mimir_appender.go` already accepts `ct` in V2 `Append(ref, ls, ct, t, ...)` (lines 59-79) and handles created timestamp; no v1 change, but ensure any v1 adapters (if present) add method.
- **Other appenders**: `storage/remote/write_handler_test` and others call `Appender`/`AppendSTZeroSample`; tests will need updates to compile.

### 3. Relevant Files
| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| prometheus | storage/interface.go | Defines `Appender` interface (lines ~291-312); add new `AppendCTZeroSample(ref SeriesRef, l labels.Labels, t, ct int64) (SeriesRef, error)` |
| prometheus | tsdb/head_append.go | Implements `storage.Appender` methods `Append`, `AppendSTZeroSample`; must implement new method and wire into head append logic |
| prometheus | storage/remote/write.go | `timestampTracker` implements `storage.Appender` methods incl. `AppendSTZeroSample`; must add new method to track counts/timestamps |
| prometheus | storage/fanout.go | `fanoutAppender` proxies all Appender methods incl. `AppendSTZeroSample`; must proxy new method to primary/secondaries |
| prometheus | util/teststorage/appender.go | Test/mock appender implementing `Appender` with `AppendSTZeroSample`; must add new method for tests |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/prometheusreceiver/internal/transaction.go | Implements `Appender`-like methods (`Append`, `AppendSTZeroSample`, histograms) bridging Prometheus -> OTLP; must satisfy updated interface |
| mimir | pkg/distributor/otlpappender/mimir_appender.go | Implements `AppenderV2` with `ct` parameter; check any v1 wrappers/adapters; V2 already handles created timestamps |
| prometheus | storage/interface_append.go | Defines V2 `AppenderV2` (already has `ct` as `st` param?); no signature change but context for implementations |
| prometheus | tsdb/agent/db_append_v2.go | Implements `AppenderV2`; no v1 change but ensure adapters compile if mixed |
| prometheus | tsdb/head_append_v2.go | V2 appender; no direct change but cross-compilation check if wrappers embed v1 |
| prometheus | storage/remote/write_handler_test.go | Uses Appender; tests must compile with new method |
| prometheus | storage/remote/write_handler.go | Handler obtains Appender; interface change impacts build |
| prometheus | storage/interface_test.go | Tests for mocks; must adjust for new method |

SUMMARY: The task is to add a new method AppendCTZeroSample to the storage.Appender interface in Prometheus, which must be implemented by all components that write time-series data. This change affects multiple implementations across Prometheus, OpenTelemetry Collector, and Mimir, including TSDB head appenders, remote write trackers, fanout appenders, and test mocks. The new method parallels the existing AppendSTZeroSample and is required to handle created timestamp zero samples.

FILES:
- prometheus/storage/interface.go — Defines the Appender interface and must add the new AppendCTZeroSample method signature.
- prometheus/tsdb/head_append.go — Implements the storage.Appender interface for TSDB head and must add the new method.
- prometheus/storage/remote/write.go — timestampTracker implements storage.Appender and must add the new method for timestamp tracking.
- prometheus/storage/fanout.go — fanoutAppender proxies Appender methods and must add the new method to proxy to primary/secondary appenders.
- prometheus/util/teststorage/appender.go — Test/mock appender implementing Appender and must add the new method for test compatibility.
- opentelemetry-collector-contrib/receiver/prometheusreceiver/internal/transaction.go — Implements Appender-like methods for OTLP-to-Prometheus conversion and must add the new method.
- mimir/pkg/distributor/otlpappender/mimir_appender.go — Implements AppenderV2 (already handles created timestamps) and may need v1 adapter updates.
- prometheus/storage/interface_append.go — Defines AppenderV2 interface; provides context for v2 implementations but no direct change needed.
- prometheus/tsdb/agent/db_append_v2.go — Implements AppenderV2; no v1 change but ensures compilation if mixed with v1.
- prometheus/tsdb/head_append_v2.go — Implements V2 appender; no direct change but checks cross-compilation with v1 wrappers.
- prometheus/storage/remote/write_handler_test.go — Uses Appender and tests must be updated to compile with the new method.
- prometheus/storage/remote/write_handler.go — Handler obtains Appender and must compile with the updated interface.
- prometheus/storage/interface_test.go — Tests for mocks and must adjust for the new method.
